content.rendered:
School Supply Packs for 2023-2024 are available online NOW! Order deadline is May 23, 2023.

Save time and money on back-to-school shopping with EPI School Supplies. Each supply box is specifically packed to match the Archer Glen Supply List for the 2023-24 individual grade levels. Supply boxes will be delivered to the school in August and will be on your student’s desk for Supply Night.

OUR SCHOOL ID: GLE072  www.EducationalProducts.com/ShopPacks
